li.p: While the seat is in the relaxion comfort seat position, press the front portion of the relaxion comfort seat switch (1) for more than approximately 1 second.
The seat cushion and seatback are returned to their original positions in the reverse order of the relaxion seat operation.
Driver’s seat: Seat position when the last shift position is in P (Park)
Passenger’s seat: Stored seat position (initial set position)
Do not operate both switches at the same time. It may damage the relaxion comfort seat system.
